scope: Source facts supporting the exact v1 Image unsupported-caption-widget classification and current capability. Observed behavior still comes from the browser trace; source inventory alone is not acceptance.

references.fact: Image extends BlockPluginAbstract, declares inlineTools=false, and does not implement mapTextFields.
The inherited abstract base also has no mapTextFields method.
The block contract says mapTextFields drives widget marshalling and undefined leaves it disabled.
Public insertInlinePlugin rejects a target whose block plugin has no mapTextFields function.
The owning text plugin enumerates HTML fields so widgets persist through save/load.
Current Image schema declares caption as a rich field, enabling its persistent inline sidecars.
Image derives alt from its completed exact caption field through afterProjection and retains ownership guards.
Renderer derives img.alt from the fragment returned by its existing parseInline path.
